desc: Parse N and string A; compute original final bit via iterative majority reduction (group triples, shrink by factor 3).

Bottom-up DP over levels: leaf g = 1; internal node recurrence g = sum of two smallest of the three children's per-child costs d_i (d_i = g_i if child original equals node original else 0) — this equals (sum d_i) − max(d_i).
Reduce level by level (discarding previous level) until one root cost remains; print g[0].
Validate against Sample 1 ("010011101" -> 1) and Sample 2 ("000" -> 2), plus edge cases ("111" -> 2, "010" -> 1, "000000000" -> 4); confirmed DAG/DP exactness and O(3^N) performance for N=13.
Rejected the incorrect unconditional "sum of two smallest child g_i" formulation; adopted the correct d_i-based recurrence which passed all sample tests.
